P6577.corridor_notes: Jilin Province's 14th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and 2035 Vision Goals (吉林省国民经济和社会发展第十四个五年规划和2035年远景目标纲要, Ch.12 Sec.4) contains the exact phrase GEM's ResearcherNotes references: '谋划推进海外天然气登陆通道建设' (plan/advance construction of an overseas natural-gas landing corridor). This is a single generic sentence in a province-wide energy-infrastructure section -- it names NO specific country, port, or Chinese landing city; Hunchun is not mentioned anywhere near it. Separately, Hunchun is confirmed as an active Russia-gas-import point, but by TRUCK, not pipeline: Hunchun customs (珲春海关) reports large and growing volumes of imported liquefied gas (LNG/LPG) from Russia's Far East (e.g. a Vladivostok-sourced LNG project, '珲春进口海参崴LNG项目'), consistent with Hunchun's role as a land-port gateway to Russia's Sea of Japan coast (adjacent to Russian ports Posyet ~42km and Zarubino ~71km away, per Chinese Wikipedia's 珲春口岸 article), but none of the customs/import articles describe a cross-border PIPELINE landing corridor -- current Russia-gas flow through Hunchun is truck-hauled LNG/LPG cargo, not piped gas. GEM's own StartProvince=Primorye-Territory/EndLocation=Hunchun framing (an ~80km cross-border spur) is plausible given the short Hunchun-to-Russian-port distances, but no independent source found in this pass connects the plan's generic 'overseas landing corridor' line to Hunchun specifically, nor names any Russian-side location.

P6577.researcher_notes: This pipeline is highly conceptual: confirmed real only as a one-line generic aspiration in Jilin's 14th Five-Year overall (not energy-specific) plan, with no route, capacity, station, or even country/port specificity attached anywhere I could find. GEM's own zh_alt gloss '(俄罗斯滨海-吉林珲春)' appears to be GEM's own prior interpretive addition rather than something stated in the plan text itself -- I could not independently corroborate the Hunchun/Primorye pairing for THIS specific project. Do not treat the Hunchun end coordinate above as sourced to a pipeline-specific document; it is only the Hunchun city-center geocode carried from GEM's pre-existing EndLocation field, offered for spatial reference. Distinguish this from Hunchun's real, well-documented truck-based Russian LNG/LPG import trade (multiple 2025-2026 customs reports), which is NOT evidence of a pipeline.
P6577.blockers: No source found that names a specific Russian start location, gives any route/corridor geometry, or independently ties the '海外天然气登陆通道' plan line to Hunchun. WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted partway through this PID's research; remaining searches were run via WebFetch against DuckDuckGo HTML results, which returned only Hunchun LNG-truck-import news, not pipeline material. A dedicated follow-up should search PipeChina/Sinopec/CNPC investment announcements and Heilongjiang/Primorsky cross-border pipeline feasibility studies (the China-Russia 'Far East' pipeline via Khabarovsk-Vladivostok, confirmed separately via the Vladivostok Chinese consulate site, crosses near the Ussuri River toward Heilongjiang, not Hunchun/Jilin -- so it is a different, larger project and should not be conflated with P6577).

P7699.corridor_notes: The Jilin Province Energy Development 14th Five-Year Plan (吉林省能源发展"十四五"规划, page ~24-25, verified via pdftotext of the archived PDF) lists '榆树－舒兰' (Yushu-Shulan) by name as one of six priority natural-gas pipeline projects under construction/planning during 2021-2025: '推进吉林－延吉、延吉－珲春、梅河口－桦甸、白山－靖宇－临江、松原－白城、榆树－舒兰等天然气管线项目建设。新建省内支干线管道1753公里，包括1条干线和15条支线' (advance construction of the Jilin-Yanji, Yanji-Hunchun, Meihekou-Huadian, Baishan-Jingyu-Linjiang, Songyuan-Baicheng, Yushu-Shulan gas pipeline projects; province-wide 1,753km of new trunk/branch pipeline, comprising 1 trunk line + 15 branches). Confirms it is one of the ~15 planned branch lines off the province's main gas backbone, but the source gives no station-level detail, alignment, or length specific to this segment. A separate 2026-01 Shulan municipal news item ('舒兰天然气管网正式通气运行' / 'total-investment-100M-yuan gas project') describes a LOCAL 54.6km medium-pressure CNG distribution network built inside Shulan's urban core, fed by trucked/CNG supply rather than a trunk pipeline from Yushu -- consistent with the Yushu-Shulan long-distance connector itself still being unbuilt (matches GEM's Status=proposed).
P7699.researcher_notes: No station-level (分输站/门站) name could be found for either endpoint despite multiple query variations ('榆树-舒兰输气管道', '舒兰 天然气管道 通气 环评', '舒兰市 天然气管道 榆树'). GEM's ResearcherNotes (already in the payload) says the original Wiki data link is invalid and no other info was found -- this pass corroborates the project's existence via an independent primary source (the province's own 14th FYP energy plan PDF, archived because the live xxgk.jl.gov.cn URL fails TLS verification through this environment -- a cert-chain issue, confirmed reachable via plain curl with 200 and via the Wayback snapshot) but could not go past county-city-level resolution for the route itself. Endpoints geocoded as Yushu and Shulan city centers/government-seat points -- the finest level sourced is the county-city name pairing itself, not a station or township.

P7700.corridor_notes: Two independent official documents describe this exact corridor under the name '吉林-延吉天然气管道' (Jilin-Yanji Natural Gas Pipeline), matching GEM's zh_alt '吉林吉化-延吉天然气管道': (1) a 2013 EIA first-public-notice from CNPC's pipeline arm (中国石油管道公司管道工程第二项目经理部, via 中石油东北炼化工程有限公司) states the route '起点为吉林市龙潭区（长岭——长春——吉林天然气管道吉化末站），终至位于延吉市大兴屯南侧的末站...沿线依次经过吉林市、延边朝鲜族自治州2个地级区域...吉林市段...经过吉林市、蛟河市，总长约136.7km；延边朝鲜族自治州路由经过敦化市、安图县、龙井市、延吉市，总长约173.6km，全线总长约310.3km。共设置9个截断阀室和3个分输站' (starts at the Jihua terminal station of the Changling-Changchun-Jilin gas pipeline in Longtan District, Jilin City; ends at a terminal station south of Daxingtun, Yanji City; passes through Jilin City, Jiaohe City, Dunhua City, Antu County, Longjing City, Yanji City; total ~310.3km; 9 block-valve chambers, 3 distribution stations). (2) A 2019-04-29 formal project approval (核准批复, 项目代码2018-222401-45-02-003878) from the Jilin Provincial Development & Reform Commission to project owner 吉林省能源集团国际管道有限公司 confirms the same start/end and route: '项目起点为吉林市拟建的兴安盟-吉林煤制天然气管道吉林末站，主要沿珲乌高速向东南方向敷设，途径蛟河市、敦化市、安图县、龙井市，最终抵达拟建的延吉综合站' -- new trunk 305km (DN813, 10MPa) + 7km branch, 3 new stations (蛟河分输站 Jiaohe, 敦化综合站 Dunhua, 延吉综合站 Yanji), 11 valve chambers, total investment RMB 1.647 billion. The same approval document also references a related, larger 2017-approved sister project extending further east to '珲春市综合站' (吉林-珲春天然气管道工程, 428km total, via Tumen and Hunchun) -- i.e. this Jilin-Yanji line is functionally the first (western) segment of a longer Jilin-to-Hunchun corridor.
P7700.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY TO FLAG: GEM's payload StartLocation for P7700 is 'Yushu', but every source found for the segment name given ('JCIC-Yanji' / zh_alt '吉林吉化-延吉天然气管道') places the true start at JIHUA/Longtan District, JILIN CITY -- not Yushu. 'JCIC' most plausibly reads as 'Jilin Chemical Industrial Company' (吉化 = 吉林化学工业公司/吉林石化), i.e. the Jihua petrochemical complex, which sits in Jilin City, ~100km northwest of Yushu. A separate, newer generation of Yanbian-serving pipelines DOES originate at Yushu (see P7699/P7705's sourcing, and a 2025 duckduckgo search hit describing a Hulin-Changchun-pipeline 'Yanji branch' [虎林—长春天然气管道延吉支线项目] starting at '虎林-长春天然气管道榆树分输清管站' [the Yushu distribution/pigging station of the Hulin-Changchun pipeline] and ending at '延吉末站' -- but that source, www.eiafans.com/thread-1440530-1-1.html, was unreachable in this pass [connection refused, no Wayback snapshot] so it is NOT used as a ref here). Two plausible readings: (a) GEM's StartLocation field is simply wrong/stale for this row and should read 'Jilin' not 'Yushu'; or (b) P7700 is meant to represent the NEWER Yushu-origin alignment and the zh_alt Chinese name is an inherited/legacy label that no longer matches the current routing. Given the zh_alt name is an exact, unambiguous match to the Jilin City-origin project documented in two strong primary sources, I have used that alignment for the coordinates above, but this should be reconciled against GEM's StartLocation field before a route candidate is finalized -- it may turn out P7700 and P7705 (Yushu-Hunchun) are describing overlapping/successor alignments of the same underlying corridor.

P7704.corridor_notes: Yanbian Prefecture's official Carbon Peaking Implementation Plan (延边州碳达峰工作实施方案, published 2023-08-07) names this exact three-city segment: '推进"气化吉林"惠民工程，以"榆树—延吉—珲春"天然气输送主干网为轴线...加快实施"榆树—敦化"连接线、"延吉—龙井—和龙"和延吉至汪清段等天然气管道项目建设...到2025年，实现天然气用气量达到5亿立方米' (advancing the 'Gasify Jilin' benefit project along the Yushu-Yanji-Hunchun trunk axis; accelerating the Yushu-Dunhua connector, the Yanji-Longjing-Helong line, and the Yanji-Wangqing segment; targeting 500 million m3/yr gas consumption by 2025). This independently corroborates GEM's own segment name and the ResearcherNotes' cited Longjing city spatial plan. That plan (龙井市智新镇国土空间总体规划2021-2035, already in the payload's ResearcherNotes, re-verified here) states Zhixin Town (智新镇, a subdivision of Longjing City that this segment passes through) will draw its long-term gas supply 'from the Yanji-Longjing-Helong natural gas [pipeline]' (远期镇区气源来自于延吉-龙井-和龙的天然气) via a new gate station (门站) to be built in Longjing's central urban district (中心城区新建门站), confirming Longjing City sits on this corridor between Yanji and Helong, though the plan gives no coordinates for that gate station.
P7704.researcher_notes: GEM's StartLocation=Yanji and EndLocation=Helong match the sourced project name '延吉-龙井-和龙' exactly, with Longjing City (龙井市) as the mid-route waypoint (matching GEM's SegmentName). No station-level (分输站/门站) name or coordinates found for either the Yanji or Helong end of this specific segment -- only city-level. The Longjing Zhixin-town plan confirms a planned gate station will exist in Longjing's central urban district but gives no siting detail. LengthMergedKm is blank in the payload ('--'); no source found gives a length for this specific segment (the parent trunk figures found -- e.g. the 305km/173.6km figures for the Jilin-Yanji and Jiaohe/Dunhua/Antu/Longjing/Yanji legs -- belong to a DIFFERENT, Jilin-City-origin corridor researched for P7700, not this Yanji-Longjing-Helong branch).

P7705.corridor_notes: Two independent official sources confirm this exact project name. (1) The Jilin Provincial Energy Bureau's 2024-07-12 formal reply to a provincial CPPCC proposal (对省政协第十三届二次会议第335号委员提案的答复, 吉能法规〔2024〕104号) states: '目前，尚有白城、延边2个市(州)和25个县(市)未通管道天然气。"十四五"期间，全省规划天然气长输管道14条，长度1503公里，其中重点规划建设虎林-长春、长春-石家庄、长岭-白城-乌兰浩特、榆树-珲春等天然气长输管道。近期，我局已推动省投资集团新能源公司开展榆树-珲春天然气管道等项目前期工作...力争早日实现向延边朝鲜族自治州供应管道天然气' (Baicheng and Yanbian prefectures plus 25 counties still lack piped gas; the Bureau has directed the Provincial Investment Group's New Energy Company to begin preliminary work on the Yushu-Hunchun gas pipeline, aiming to bring piped gas to Yanbian). This is a distinct, more recent project than the 2017-approved 'Jilin-Hunchun' (吉林-珲春) line researched for P7700/its 428km sister project -- the 2024 document frames Yushu-Hunchun as still in early preliminary-work stage, consistent with GEM's Status=proposed. (2) The Yanbian Prefecture Carbon Peaking Plan (2023-08-07) independently names the same corridor as the region's core axis: '以"榆树—延吉—珲春"天然气输送主干网为轴线' (with the Yushu-Yanji-Hunchun gas trunk as the axis), i.e. this Yushu-Hunchun line is the same trunk that P7700 (Yanji leg) and P7704 (Yanji-Longjing-Helong branch) connect off of.
P7705.researcher_notes: This is best understood as the trunk axis of the whole Yanbian gas-supply network described across this PID group: 榆树-延吉-珲春 (Yushu-Yanji-Hunchun) is the main line; P7699 (Yushu-Shulan), and the P7704 (Yanji-Longjing-Helong) branch, plus an unresearched 'Yushu-Dunhua' connector and 'Yanji-Wangqing' segment mentioned in the same source, hang off it. No station-level name found for either Yushu or Hunchun ends specifically for THIS segment (a separate, unreachable source describing a related 'Hulin-Changchun pipeline Yanji branch' names a '榆树分输清管站' [Yushu distribution/pigging station] as a Yushu-area station, but that source could not be verified/reached in this pass, so it is not cited here -- flagging for a follow-up attempt). LengthMergedKm is blank in the payload ('--'); no specific length found for this segment (the 2017-approved sister project 吉林-珲春, a DIFFERENT Jilin-City-origin corridor, is 428km, not directly applicable here).
